summary: Build NIST cybersecurity program and risk-management skills with PECB NIST Cybersecurity Lead Implementer training and exam preparation.
audienceIntro: This NIST Cybersecurity Lead Implementer course is for professionals responsible for applying NIST guidance, assessing security controls, or coordinating cybersecurity programs and incident response.
audience: Digital forensics investigators using cybersecurity frameworks
prerequisites: PECB states that you need a fundamental understanding of cybersecurity principles and frameworks to participate in this training course.
